body.name: Staff of Gluttony
body.description: Forged from the antlers of a wendigo, this staff devours the life force of those it touches, hungering eternally for more.

body.name: Starfish
body.description: A marine creature that inhabits the sea. Commonly found in shallow coastal waters, among reefs, or along sandy seabeds.

body.name: Stefan Beret
body.description: A decorative hat for a bard’s performance. Embellished with embroidery and feathers, it radiates an old-fashioned elegance as its rich folds cascade gracefully to the back.

body.name: Sterling Axe
body.description: A two-handed axe forged of silver, powerful against undead foes.

body.name: Sterling Blade
body.description: A two-handed blade melded with sterling silver, used to combat the undead.

body.name: Sterling Bow
body.description: A sturdy bow made of sterling silver, deftly piercing undead foes.

body.name: Sterling Dagger
body.description: A sharp dagger intricately forged with silver, shaped to puncture undead enemies.

body.name: Sterling Rod
body.description: A compact mace made of sterling silver, designed for undead slaying.

body.name: Sterling Short Sword
body.description: A solid silver short sword, crafted to swiftly eliminate undead.

body.name: Sterling Staff
body.description: A staff fused with sterling silver, melded to combat the undead. A silent threat to any undead that dare approach.

body.name: Sticky Tongue
body.description: A tongue cut from the slobber-soaked maw of a Cerberus. Its damp, slippery texture evokes a strong sense of disgust.

body.name: Stiletto Dagger
body.description: A slim and subtle assassination weapon with a thick, sturdy hilt that allows for masterful combat techniques.
